sheets.title: Reporting Hierarchy — CPO input requirements vs AMP-2548
sheets.subtitle: Gap analysis · prepared by Huyen (PO) · 03/09/2026
sheets.meta: Sources: AMP-2548 v1, ACP-226/227/258, AMP-3323, ADIB-5651/6725/7172. Coverage: 0 Covered · 3 Partially covered · 3 Not covered
rows: Sale code / staff ID user can view only the applications tagged to them on the Enquiry screens.
AC4 pre-filter on Assigned To before all existing filters; IM005 empty state; AC6 applies to both enquiry screens.

The filter has no data to run on: no AC defines how a case gets Assigned To at origination and the user record has no Staff ID attribute. Add capture ACs + user-record field with uniqueness, maker/checker, audit.
Manager can view all applications tagged to the users under them.
AC1–AC3 Reporting Manager field; AC5 recursive subtree traversal; AC7 maker/checker.
Context says direct reports while AC5 says full subtree; lifecycle rules missing (cycles, deactivating a manager, mid-flight RM change).
Case tagging basis — Staff ID or UTM
Decide the attribution key considering the UTM concept and the precedent's sale/promo code usage.
Decision: tag by Staff ID (person-level). UTM identifies the link/owner and its share model changes visibility dynamically. Staff ID carried in the URL + customer entry + round-robin default.
Roles that process all applications keep access after the restriction.
Not addressed — every enquiry user is forced into the filter.
Add a view-all override (or a department rule) and define who gets it at migration; otherwise the release is a visibility regression for operations.
Who sees applications with no staff tag; what happens to existing data at go-live.
Not addressed — Impact Analysis covers Maker/Checker only.
Round-robin default from a config table; explicit audience for untagged and historical cases; backfill rule.
Report Enquiry follows the same visibility
Reports and exports scoped to own cases / subtree.
AC6 Report Enquiry row incl. export scope.
Baseline references are broken (ACP-229 does not exist; ACP-228 is cancelled). Point to the correct baseline or descope.
